output.reason: The changelog line [ev-4c42b6db5d61] is vague by itself, but the linked PR [ev-d2b4c4f5b873] says what changed: a new push endpoint, `/otlp/v1/logs`, that accepts OTLP logs in JSON or protobuf. The second part of the PR [ev-4896c62dfbb0] says how that data is stored: selected resource attributes become index labels, the remaining ones are stored as structured metadata, and the timestamp and log line come from LogRecord.TimeUnixNano and LogRecord.Body. That is enough to type the change as an added API endpoint, with applicability limited to environments whose clients choose to push to the new endpoint. The consequence is additive, meaning nothing changes for an operator who does not use it. The PR text is cut off, so any prerequisites it lists (for example, whether structured metadata must be enabled) are not shown, but they would only narrow who can use the endpoint and would not change what an operator who does nothing experiences.
